Every lesson distinguishes outline from silhouette, and the 30×30 stress query contains a real 5×5 selected object plus four distractors.

It reserves actual motion cells across objects, permutes the side key, and supplies a 30×30 query with 24 side-colored markers and 12 unmatched distractors. The existing base tests were made portable without weakening their behavioral checks.

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The color-to-direction map together with each marker source, assigned direction, and resulting destination.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Read the four uniform border-side colors and decode each color into its top, bottom, left, or right direction; assign that direction to every matching interior marker.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Consume the marker-direction assignments and advance each marker by the episode travel distance, preserving unmatched distractors and the border.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The renderer receives no geometric direction except through Stage A. Replacing the decoded map with an all-up map while retaining two-step travel changes the protected-Racket final grid on the same input.

parametric_work.summary: Episode-fixed travel_mode preserves the exact-canonical one-step rule or moves two cells using the same decoded color-to-direction map; every sample retains fully blocked and one-step-only boundary cases, supports 2–6 demos, and has exactly four queries.
